entries.appliesTo: Tennessee Advisory Commission on Intergovernmental Relations (TACIR)

sources.program: § 1(a) — 'The Tennessee Advisory Commission on Intergovernmental Relations (TACIR) shall conduct a study and produce a report on artificial intelligence.'

flags: One-time study/report mandate only; no ongoing compliance duty on any party — report due to governor and speakers 'no later than January 31, 2027' (§ 1(c))
Title recites amendment of Titles 29, 33, 39 and 47, but the enacted text contains only the TACIR study mandate and an effective-date section
Study scope covers dangerous-prompt and chatbot emotional-support/mental-health risks (§ 1(b)(4)-(5)) but imposes no chatbot-safeguards duties on operators
